reviewSamples.author: J Louisa
reviewSamples.text: Best ever. Anwaar will treat you well and knows his stuff when it comes to issues with you vehicle. He has saved me a number of times at reasonable prices than going to a dealership. Highly recommend.

reviewSamples.author: Luis Diaz
reviewSamples.text: Anwar is the best mechanic in the area, great person awesome service, great pricessss, ala bless him!!!! and his beutiful family!!

reviewSamples.author: Andrea Bryant
reviewSamples.text: I was referred to Mr. Anwaar as being someone who is very knowledgeable in being able to fix my car a/c. Upon meeting Mr. Anwaar I found him to be very kind and courteous. He speaks to you with such a calming spirit.

reviewSamples.author: George Aloy
reviewSamples.text: Anwaar is real professional and an excellent mechanic with fair prices. Anwaar and his staff are wonderful automotive specialists. Excellent in customer service. I would rate them 5 stars and 2 big thumbs up.

reviewSamples.author: peoples305
reviewSamples.text: Been coming to Anwaar's for 10 plus years. Always great services and affordable prices, and more important, honest!! He's a mechanic that you can trust. Any friends and family I sent his way were very happy with the work he has provided.
